evidence.original_label: 皮秒激光划片设备 崩边 ≤10μm

notes: Maximum edge chipping for HG Laser’s picosecond laser wafer dicing family, printed as an unambiguous upper bound. Chipping is the standard quality figure of merit by which laser dicing is compared against blade dicing. Locator 1 is a single archived HTML product page, not a PDF page; the page carries no publication date, so the period is collapsed to the archive date, which is the only date the atlas can attest and is not a disclosure period. The excerpt reproduces the source’s own consecutive text lines, joined with ¦ to mark each line break; the separator is editorial.

notes: Scribe-line width of the LUD3210 model, the finer of the two in the same table. The source writes ≤20±5μm: only the printed bound of 20 is recorded, for the same reason as the LUD3200 row, and the ±5μm tolerance is not expressible in the relation vocabulary. The parameter table is two-column and binds values positionally: the 设备型号 header lists LUD3200 then LUD3210, and every parameter row below emits its LUD3200 value first and its LUD3210 value second, a pattern consistent across 中心波长, 加工头, 有效工作行程, 重复定位精度 and 视觉定位. The excerpt therefore runs from the 主要技术参数 heading through the 划线线宽 values so the column order is auditable rather than asserted.
